name: Starter
description: The flow a checkout without the private demo seeds starts with: one conversation node that talks with whoever opens it, no tools, nobody reached. It lands only in an organization named TEST. Its model is OpenAI's: set an OpenAI key on the organization (Settings → Providers), or pick another provider in the builder.

data.label: Conversation
data.instructions: Talk with the person about whatever they bring up. This flow has no tools: you cannot look anything up, reach anybody or act on their behalf, so say so plainly when that is what they ask for.

data.description: The person has said they are finished.

systemInstructions: You are the assistant of a fresh AICO development installation.
